flags.help: Use CUDA for GPU Acceleration. Requires CUDA. Enter a number afterwards to select and use 1 GPU. Leaving no number will use all GPUs.
Use Vulkan for GPU Acceleration. Can optionally specify one or more GPU Device ID (e.g. --usevulkan 0), leave blank to autodetect.
Do not use any GPU acceleration (CPU Only)
Model file to load. Accepts multiple values if they are URLs.
Load settings from a .kcpps file. Other arguments will be ignored
Controls the memory allocated for maximum context size, only change if you need more RAM for big contexts. (default 16384).
Set number of layers to offload to GPU (when using GPU). Set to -1 to enable autofit (default), set to 0 to disable GPU offload.
Host IP to listen on. If this flag is not set, all routable interfaces are accepted.
Launches a web browser when load is completed.
For CUDA and Vulkan only, ratio to split tensors across multiple GPUs, space-separated list of proportions, e.g. 7 3
Use a custom number of threads if specified. Otherwise, uses an amount based on CPU cores
Port to listen on. (Defaults to 5001)
Prints version and exits.
Launches the simple KoboldCpp Agent in a new terminal window, or the current terminal with --cli.
Reads the metadata, weight types and tensor names in any GGUF or safetensors file.
Forces autofit, which attempts to fit the model in the best possible way. Overrides everything else.
How much spare allowance in MB should autofit reserve? If it's too little, the load might fail.
Sets the logical batch size used in batched processing (default 512). Setting it to -1 disables batched mode, but keeps other benefits like GPU offload.
Sets the physical batch size used in batched processing. Setting it to -1 uses the same value as batchsize (default).
Do not start server, instead run benchmarks. If filename is provided, appends results to provided file.
Use a different number of threads during batching if specified. Otherwise, has the same value as --threads
Select an optional ChatCompletions Adapter JSON file to force custom instruct tags.
Runs interactive terminal chat without an HTTP server. With --agent, runs the agent in this terminal using a loopback HTTP server.

Shows additional debug info in the terminal. Levels: -1 (Horde-quiet, suppresses non-essential prints; auto-applied when Horde args are set), 0 (default, normal output), 1 (verbose: extra slot/cache info, larger print buffers, retains horde-debug prefix). Passing the flag without a value implies 1.
How many tokens to generate by default, if not specified. Must be smaller than context size. Usually, your frontend GUI will override this.
Set llama.cpp compatible device selection override. Comma separated. Overrides normal device choices.
Specify a directory that models will be downloaded to or searched from, if unset uses the working directory.
How many tokens to draft per chunk before verifying results
How many layers to offload to GPU for the draft model (default=full offload)
GPU layer distribution ratio for draft model (default=same as main). Only works if multi-GPUs selected for MAIN model and tensor_split is set!
Load a small draft model for speculative decoding. It will be fully offloaded. Vocab must match the main model.
Enables the use of Classifier-Free-Guidance, which allows the use of negative prompts. Has performance and memory impact.
Exports the current selected arguments as a .kcpps settings file
Exports the current selected arguments as a .kcppt template file
Use failsafe mode, extremely old CPU compatibility mode that should work on all devices.
Windows only. Sends the terminal to the foreground every time a new prompt is generated. This helps avoid some idle slowdown issues.
Sets extra default parameters for some fields in API requests, as a JSON string.
Allow the gendefaults parameters to overwrite the original value in API payloads.
Sets the maximum number of generated tokens, it will restrict all generations to this or lower. Also usable with --prompt or --benchmark.
Experimental flag. If set, increases the process CPU priority, potentially speeding up generation. Use caution.
Ignores all missing non-essential files, just skipping them instead.
Enables using jinja chat template formatting for chat completions endpoint. Other endpoints are unaffected. Tool calls are done without jinja.
Set additional fields for Jinja JSON template parser, must be a valid JSON object.
Enables using jinja chat template formatting for chat completions endpoint. Other endpoints are unaffected. Tool calls are done with jinja.
Select a custom Jinja chat template, will overwrite model jinja chat template
A quick way to enable or disable thinking in the jinja template.
GGUF models only, applies a lora file on top of model.
Multiplier for the Text LORA model to be applied.
If supported by the backend, do not offload KV to GPU (lowvram mode). Not recommended, will be slow.
Only used in a multi-gpu setup. Sets the index of the main GPU that will be used.
Specify a max request payload size. Any requests to the server larger than this size will be dropped. Do not change if unsure.
Specify path to mcp.json which contains the Cladue Desktop compatible MCP server config.
Select a multimodal projector file for vision models.
Force CLIP for Vision mmproj always on CPU.
Keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU. If no value is provided, applies to all layers.
Keep the dense FFN weights of the first N layers in the CPU. If no value is provided, applies to all layers.
How many experts to use for MoE models (default=follow gguf)
Set maximum number of queued incoming requests allowed.
Hosts a shared multiplayer session that others can join.
Allows insecure SSL connections. Use this if you have cert errors and need to bypass certificate restrictions.
If set, do not attempt to fast forward GGUF context (always reprocess). Will also enable noshift
Disables flash attention.
Do not use AVX2 instructions, a slower compatibility mode for older devices.
Prevents BOS token from being added at the start of any prompt. Usually NOT recommended for most models.
Disables MMQ, only used for cuda backend. This flag may be removed in future.
Allows you to launch the GUI alone, without selecting any model.
If set, do not attempt to Trim and Shift the GGUF context.
If set, uses full-size SWA KV Cache. Otherwise, SWA will be enabled automatically on models that support it. SWA saves memory but cannot be used with context shifting.
An optional shell command to execute after the model has been loaded.
Allow .kcpps config files loaded after launch to set --onready commands. Only use with trusted configs.
Override metadata value by key. Separate multiple values with commas. Format is name=type:value. Types: int, float, bool, str
Overrides the native trained context of the loaded model with a custom value to be used for Rope scaling.
Override selected backend for specific tensors matching tensor_name_regex_pattern=buffer_type, same as in llama.cpp.
Allows multiple requests to be batched and executed in parallel. Only works for basic text generation requests (Experimental, No media)
Enter a password required to use this instance. This key will be required for all text endpoints. Image endpoints are not secured. Can also be set with env var KCPP_PASSWORD
Configures a prepared story json save file to be hosted on the server, which frontends (such as KoboldAI Lite) can access over the API.
Passing a prompt string triggers a direct inference, loading the model, outputs the response to stdout and exits. Can be used alone or with benchmark.
Sets the KV cache data type quantization, options are f16/bf16/q8_0/q5_1/q4_0. Requires Flash Attention for full effect, otherwise only K cache is quantized.
Enable quiet mode, which hides generation inputs and outputs in the terminal. Quiet mode is automatically enabled when running a horde worker.
If enabled, rate limit generative request by IP address. Each IP can only send a new request once per X seconds.
A quick way to set the default reasoning effort. API values override this.
Uses Cloudflare to create a remote tunnel, allowing you to access koboldcpp remotely over the internet even behind a firewall.

If set, uses customized RoPE scaling from configured frequency scale and frequency base (e.g. --ropeconfig 0.25 10000). Otherwise, uses NTK-Aware scaling set automatically based on context size. For linear rope, simply set the freq-scale and ignore the freq-base
If enabled, creates or opens a persistent database file on the server, that allows users to save and load their data remotely. A new file is created if it does not exist.
Allows this KoboldCpp instance to be shut down by any new instance requesting the same port, preventing duplicate servers from clashing on a port.
Enables intelligent context switching by saving KV cache snapshots to RAM. Requires fast forwarding.
Reserving a portion of context to try processing less frequently. Outdated. Not recommended.
How to split the model across multiple GPUs
Allows all content to be served over SSL instead. A valid UNENCRYPTED SSL cert and key .pem files must be provided
How much extra to pad the SWA KV cache, this affects the rewind limit before reprocessing is forced.
Extracts the file contents of the KoboldCpp binary into a target directory.
Enables MTP layers to be used for drafting (speculative decoding) if present
Enables mlock, preventing the RAM used to load the model from being paged out. Not usually recommended.
If set, uses mmap to load model.
Use direct I/O to load GGUF models if available. May improve cold-load times on some storage.
Clamp MMProj vision maximum allowed resolution. Allowed values are between 512 to 2048 px (default 1024).
Override the maximum tokens for the MMProj embedding (default -1).
Override the minimum tokens for the MMProj embedding (default -1).
Enable the local search engine proxy so Web Searches can be done.
Always show the GUI instead of launching the model right away when loading settings from a .kcpps file.
Doesn't display or use the GUI launcher. Overrides showgui.
Sets your AI Horde display model name.
Sets your AI Horde worker name.
Sets your AI Horde API key.
Sets the maximum context length your worker will accept from an AI Horde job. If 0, matches main context limit.
Sets the maximum number of tokens your worker will generate from an AI horde job.
Specify an image generation audio VAE for LTX2.3 video generation.
If specified, limit generation steps and image size for shared use. Accepts an extra optional parameter that indicates maximum resolution (eg. 768 clamps to 768x768, min 512px, disabled if 0).

If specified, limit max image size to curb memory usage. Similar to --sdclamped, but less strict, allows trade-offs between width and height (e.g. 640 would allow 640x640, 512x768 and 768x512 images).
Specify first safetensors Clip model (SD3 or Flux Clip-L, WAN or QwenImg vision). Leave blank if prebaked or unused.
Specify second safetensors Clip model (SD3 Clip-G). Leave blank if prebaked or unused.
CLIP / T5 / LLM device for image generation. GPU index, -1 or 'main' for the main GPU, or 'CPU' (default: CPU).

Enables Conv2D Direct. May improve performance or reduce memory usage. Might crash if not supported by the backend. Can be 'off' (default) to disable, 'full' to turn it on for all operations, or 'vaeonly' to enable only for the VAE.
Enables Flash Attention for image generation.
Specify image generation LoRAs safetensors models to be applied. Multiple LoRAs are accepted.
Multipliers for the image LoRA model to be applied.
If specified, Image Generation weights will be placed on the selected GPU index. GPU index, -1 or 'main' for the main GPU, or 'CPU' (default: 'main')
Specify an image generation safetensors or gguf model to enable image generation.
Offload image weights in RAM to save VRAM, swap into VRAM when needed.
PhotoMaker is a model that allows face cloning. Specify a PhotoMaker safetensors model which will be applied replacing img2img. SDXL models only. Leave blank if unused.
If specified, loads the model quantized to save memory. 0=off, 1=q8, 2=q4
Specify an image generation text encoder or LLM (.safetensors or .gguf). Leave blank if prebaked or unused.
Use a different number of threads for image generation if specified. Otherwise, has the same value as --threads.
Adjust the automatic VAE tiling trigger for images above this size. 0 disables vae tiling.
You can use ESRGAN as an upscaling model to resize images. Leave blank if unused.
Specify an image generation safetensors VAE which replaces the one in the model.
Uses a built-in tiny VAE via TAE SD, which is very fast, and fixed bad VAEs.
VAE device for image generation. GPU index, -1 or 'main' for the main GPU, or 'CPU' (default: main).
If set, prevent VRAM usage from image gen from using more than this many MB.
Specify a Whisper .bin model to enable Speech-To-Text transcription.
Specify the TTS Text-To-Speech GGUF model.
Specify the WavTokenizer GGUF model.
Use the GPU for TTS.
Limit number of audio tokens generated with TTS.
Use a different number of threads for TTS if specified. Otherwise, has the same value as --threads.
Select directory containing voices for voice cloning.
Select music LLM model (e.g acestep-5Hz-lm-0.6B)
Select music embedding model (e.g Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B)
Select music diffusion (DiT) model (e.g acestep-v15-turbo)
Select music VAE model
Unload music models when not in use
Specify an embeddings model to be loaded for generating embedding vectors.
Overrides the default maximum supported context of an embeddings model (defaults to trained context).
Attempts to offload layers of the embeddings model to GPU. Usually not needed.
RPC allows GPUs to be shared over the network. connect=access a remote GPU, host=share your GPU
RPC host mode only. Port for RPC server to listen on (default: 5551).
RPC host mode only. IP address for RPC server to listen on. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, 127.0.0.1 for localhost only.
RPC host mode only. Set specific devices to use for RPC server. Comma separated. Overrides normal RPC device choices.
RPC connect mode only. Specify a comma separated list of remote RPC endpoints to connect to e.g. 127.0.0.1:5551,127.0.0.1:5552
Enables admin mode, allowing you to unload and reload different configurations or models.
Require a password to access admin functions. You are strongly advised to use one for publically accessible instances! Can also be set with env var KCPP_ADMINPASSWORD
Specify a directory to look for .kcpps configs in, which can be used to swap models.
Set an idle timeout in seconds after which KoboldCpp will automatically unload the current model.
Router mode uses a reverse proxy router, allowing you to easily hotswap models and configs within a single request. Requires admin mode.
Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests.

Autoswap mode builds on router mode to allow switching of model types within the same config automatically. Requires admin mode and router mode. All models desired must be defined within the same config.
Keep model families at or below this combined file size resident in autoswap mode, in MB (default 256). Only one model family above the threshold is loaded at a time.
Specify a base .kcpps config to apply, if no custom base config is selected during a model swap
